verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat and agent platform, so in-chat interactive UI for apps is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no developer-facing interactive message components: no modals, buttons, or structured block layouts. Canvases, workflow approvals via CLI, and NIP-29 group chat messages are related features, not a UI-component framework for apps, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build apps with rich interactive UI inside chat — modals, buttons, and structured message layouts
